entries.story_action: Pandora is already inside the chamber. She registers something beyond frame before the house wakes.
entries.animation_behavior: Hold authored composition; candle flames breathe independently, rain moves beyond glass, slight cloth/hair response; nearly imperceptible depth drift.

entries.story_action: The first song texture reveals the impossible relation between Pandora, window, rain and distant house.
entries.animation_behavior: Use source-video motion and a derived rear/window composition; move from interior reflection toward exterior depth without explaining geography.
music_cues: song opening texture; first pulse emergence
entries.lyric_cue: There is a house beneath the rain

entries.story_action: The exterior appears inside the window while candle reflections face back toward Pandora.
entries.visual_media: U03 + U08 — Every window faces in
entries.animation_behavior: Rain glass and reflections move on separate planes; candlelight breathes; restrained lateral camera drift.
entries.lyric_cue: Where every window faces in

entries.story_action: Pandora crosses the threshold and deliberately leaves wet footprints behind.
entries.animation_behavior: Cut from full-body commitment to boots/wet stone insert; use real-pixel reframe and short perspective travel.
entries.lyric_cue: I left my footsteps at the doorway / So the dark would know I'd been

entries.story_action: A close hand nears old fragments; dust rises toward her fingers instead of falling.
entries.animation_behavior: Localized particle advection toward hand; tiny specular response on fragments; no face regeneration.
music_cues: measured mid-tempo pulse; sparse vocal space
entries.lyric_cue: Dust remembers every hand

entries.story_action: Tarnished iron catches a remembered heat as Pandora passes.
entries.animation_behavior: Localized heat memory only on metal/fire region; ember drift and practical-light breath; red cloth moves independently.
entries.lyric_cue: Iron remembers flame

entries.story_action: Pandora listens. The room seems to pronounce her silence through shifting reflections and light.
entries.animation_behavior: Reflection delay, candle breath, slight wall-shadow movement; slow focus breath from architecture to face.
entries.lyric_cue: I heard the walls pronounce my silence

entries.story_action: A mirror fragment gives a first impossible hint that Pandora is not temporally alone.
entries.animation_behavior: Editorial move from hero portrait to fractured reflection; no morphing; preserve exact identity and let the reflection arrive a fraction late.
entries.lyric_cue: Like they almost knew my name

entries.story_action: The chamber becomes more active while Pandora stays still: rain, candles, roses and curtains all respond on separate rhythms.
entries.animation_behavior: Independent rain/candle/rose/cloth motion; camera slowly pulls away to prepare scale expansion.
entries.lyric_cue: Like they almost knew my name

entries.story_action: Pandora turns from the familiar chamber and follows the red continuity thread deeper into the house.
entries.visual_media: U09 + U03 — Commit to the interior
entries.animation_behavior: Use red-cloak/fabric continuity across angle change; decisive forward camera travel.
entries.lyric_cue: instrumental lead-in to chorus

entries.story_action: The first chorus opens the house into a cathedral corridor far larger than the chamber could contain.
entries.animation_behavior: Wide architectural reveal with bounded perspective travel and a decisive lift on the downbeat; Pandora remains small but readable.
music_cues: full industrial percussion; distorted guitar stabs
entries.lyric_cue: Do not wake the sleeping distance

entries.story_action: The impossible corridor behaves like a sleeping organism without deforming its architecture.
entries.animation_behavior: Separate haze, distant candles, rain traces and light shafts; slow depth travel; no whole-frame wobble.
entries.lyric_cue: Do not ask the night to stay

entries.story_action: Inward-facing windows repeat through the distance and reflections begin showing incompatible versions of the same room.
entries.animation_behavior: Deterministic layered composite with clean perspective changes; no generative morph.
entries.lyric_cue: Somewhere under all our leaving

entries.story_action: A thin pale light appears impossibly far away, the first visible evidence of the unmade day.
entries.visual_media: U08/U10 derived — First seam of dawn
entries.animation_behavior: Localized dawn seam grows subtly while foreground candles remain warm; independent atmosphere and floor reflection.
entries.lyric_cue: There is still an unmade day

entries.story_action: Pandora faces the distant light and advances rather than retreating.
entries.animation_behavior: Strong but controlled push/lift; cloak/fabric carries screen direction into next section.
entries.lyric_cue: There is still an unmade day

entries.story_action: With the drums gone, the room becomes physically wrong: small objects begin moving on conflicting gravity vectors.
entries.animation_behavior: Independent cloth, dust, petals, hair and hanging elements drift in different directions; Pandora remains visually stable.
music_cues: drums drop out; rhythmic breathing returns
entries.lyric_cue: The ceiling fills with quiet thunder

entries.story_action: Architecture rotates in meaning rather than through cheap whole-frame spin; floor and ceiling exchange visual authority.
entries.animation_behavior: Use bounded perspective transformation and angle change across two derived shots; keep Pandora upright as reference.
entries.lyric_cue: The floor forgets which way is down

entries.story_action: The corridor repeats beyond logical distance as the distorted synth bass returns.
entries.animation_behavior: Forward travel through repeated real architectural layers; variation in scale and parallax prevents a simple loop.
entries.lyric_cue: You're standing in the hallway / Though the hallway had no end

entries.story_action: The cracked mirror reveals a second temporal state of Pandora moving slightly out of phase.
entries.animation_behavior: Reflection echo only inside mirror regions; face identity remains exact; ambient candle/rain motion continues independently.
entries.lyric_cue: You're standing in the hallway

entries.story_action: A hand crosses red fabric toward the temporal surface; the gesture is slow and deliberate.
entries.animation_behavior: Localized cloth tension, tiny ring/specular sweep, shallow focus breath; no global camera shake.
entries.lyric_cue: I reached for you

entries.story_action: Fragments, mirror and hand coverage alternate as two versions of one moment approach alignment.
entries.animation_behavior: Shorter editorial coverage on measured sync points; consistent screen direction and exact hand/identity continuity.
entries.lyric_cue: and touched the moment

entries.story_action: For a single beat, present Pandora and remembered human Pandora align perfectly in the mirror. The house falls still.
entries.animation_behavior: Reflection phase offset converges to zero; environmental motion decays nearly to stillness; restrained light lift.
entries.lyric_cue: Before strangers become friends

entries.story_action: The second chorus detonates spatially: corridor and chamber now coexist through match cuts and layered depth.
entries.animation_behavior: Fast but readable coverage on sync points; red fabric maintains continuity across impossible spaces.
music_cues: full band return; driving industrial beat
entries.lyric_cue: Do not wake the sleeping distance

entries.story_action: Pandora's red fabric visually crosses shot boundaries, stitching separated rooms into one temporal body.
entries.visual_media: U09/U04 derived — Red thread across rooms
entries.animation_behavior: Cloth motion and rose-petal drift bridge derived living scenes; audio-reactive light strength is smoothed.
entries.lyric_cue: Do not ask the night to stay

entries.story_action: Window, mirror, cathedral and chamber interlock without losing geographic intention: every route leads deeper.
entries.visual_media: U03 + U10 + U13 — House folds inward
entries.animation_behavior: Layered perspective and reflection gates create genuine progression, not repeated portrait reframes.
music_cues: chorus sync points around 126-132 video seconds
entries.lyric_cue: Somewhere under all our leaving

entries.story_action: The pale unmade dawn appears under doors, in floor reflections and inside cracks rather than from a normal horizon.
entries.visual_media: U14 derived + U10 — Dawn leaks below
entries.animation_behavior: Localized pale light migration, floor shimmer, haze shafts and candle response; preserve blacks and highlights.
entries.lyric_cue: There is still an unmade day

entries.story_action: Pandora stops chasing the distant light and turns downward toward the crypt, carrying its pale reflection with her.
entries.visual_media: U09 + U14 — Carry the day downward
entries.animation_behavior: Decisive direction change and descent transition; red-to-stone visual match.
music_cues: chorus release; transition into heavy pads
entries.lyric_cue: There is still an unmade day

entries.story_action: The crypt is revealed as the oldest memory layer: coffin, stone, roses and candles storing abandoned time.
entries.animation_behavior: Candle flame, petal drift, subtle haze and localized reflection; very restrained camera descent.
entries.lyric_cue: If the morning finds this house

entries.story_action: Pale light moves through cracks and beneath stone while candles quietly surrender brightness.
entries.visual_media: U14 derived detail — Morning enters without sound
entries.animation_behavior: Slow temporal palette migration; dawn shaft and candle fade are independent; no white blowout.
entries.lyric_cue: Let it enter without sound

entries.story_action: Pandora rises or stands fully present as cloak/shadow opens into a wing-like geometry; the human and vampire temporal states are no longer separated.
entries.animation_behavior: Controlled reveal from crypt intimacy to centered monumental composition; no monster transformation or identity rewrite.
entries.lyric_cue: We were never lost

entries.story_action: The final image holds Pandora inside the impossible dawn she can inhabit. Rain continues far above; the house no longer pulls at her.
entries.visual_media: U15 + U01 derived close — Underground day
entries.animation_behavior: Reduce motion toward stillness: faint cloth/hair response, distant haze and minimal practical-light decay; end on stable face/silhouette.
entries.lyric_cue: We were underground
entries.transition: fade to black after audio end
